subject: general
question: 'Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav', launched on ________, is an initiative by the Government of India to celebrate 75 years of Indian Independence.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12 March 2021.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav:**

__
 
• It is an initiative **launched by the Government of India.**
 
• The **launch date of the initiative was 12 March 2021.**
 
• It is **aimed at celebrating 75 years of Indian Independence.**
 
• It includes a series of events and activities to be held across the country throughout the year, including cultural events, exhibitions, and seminars.
 
• It also aims to showcase India's achievements in various fields over the past 75 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**The** five themes of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav** are:

 
• Freedom Struggle.
 
• Ideas@75.
 
• Resolve@75.
 
• Actions@75.
 
• Achievements@75.
